h: NDLEA arrests a South African woman and a Nigerian-American grandmother at Lagos airport
p: The anti-narcotics agency has reportedly detained two travellers at the Lagos airport, one of them a South African woman said to have been carrying about 36 kilograms of cocaine. The second is a Nigerian-American grandmother. Further details on the second case were not immediately available.
more: The South African woman was reportedly found with 36.65kg of the drug.
The agency has not said when the suspects will be charged.
